items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I joined, uh, Bill Eckstein's place... when I joined the band, somewhere around 46

ctx.x: Uh-uh, that's okay. All right, thank you. Give me a minute. Cigarettes.

Got the cigarettes? Got the cigarettes? Did you buy my cigarettes? Mm-hmm. Oh. Well, it's not on the thing, on the top of the thing. So, uh, Bill? Do you want my name, Jeff? No, thank you. I mean, uh, hi, Evan. Yeah. So, uh, well, these deckhands used to complain to the captain, see? So, the captain cut that out. The captain told Pichon, don't leave these musicians practice at all because they disturbed the deckhands and all that. He said, as long as you practice from 10 o'clock to 12 o'clock in the daytime.…
